comment: Build config for @backthread/ci. Mirrors @backthread/extractor's so the two packages compile under one set of rules: `module: preserve` (bundler-style resolution, matching the hosts that consume this) while still emitting Node-ESM .js + .d.ts to dist/. Imports carry explicit .js extensions, so the output runs under plain Node and bundles cleanly. Tests + the node:test/expect shim are excluded from the published build; they typecheck through tsconfig.test.json.
